units.source_text: 如果手記裡寫的都是事實，如果我也是他朋友的話，說不定也會帶他去精神病醫院。」

en.t: If everything written in the notebooks was true, and if I had been his friend too, I might well have taken him to a psychiatric hospital.
It was all his father's fault.

units.source_text: 「我們認識的小葉，性格直率，為人聰慧，

en.t: The Yozo we knew was straightforward and clever,

units.source_text: 他要是不喝酒的話，不，即使喝酒……也是一個像神一樣純粹的好人。」

en.t: if only he had not drunk, no, even when he did drink... he was a good person, as pure as a god.

units.source_text: [1]由威士忌和蘇打水兌制的雞尾酒。

en.t: [1] A cocktail made by mixing whisky with soda water.
